newsitem.title: UK: David S. Smith dives on profit warning.
newsitem.headline: David S. Smith dives on profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Britain's David S. Smith Plc dived in pre-market trade on Wednesday after the group posted first- half pre-tax profits at the top end of expectations but warned earnings in the second half would be lower than in the first.
By 0830 GMT shares in the paper and packaging group were down 14 1/2 pence at 292.
The group announced a dip in first-half profits to 58.6 million sterling from 59.6 million a year ago. Analysts had forecast pre-tax profits between 52.0 and 58.0 million stg.
Chairman Alan Clements said the firm would continue to find trading conditions challenging until a sustained recovery took hold in Europe.

"This remains our view and as a result of a fiercely competitive trading environment, combined with the recent strength in sterling, we expect earnings in the second half to be lower than in the first," he added.
Other paper and packaging stocks also dropped with Arjo Wiggins Plc down 1-1/2p at 157-1/2, Rexam Plc down 2-1/2p at 338-1/2 and Low & Bonar Plc down 1p at 416-1/2.
